cast.A: short black hair, mustard yellow knit sweater, dark blue jeans
cast.B: curly brown hair tied back, green long-sleeve shirt, black trousers

scenes.scene: short black hair, mustard yellow knit sweater, dark blue jeans steps through a winter doorway, one hand jerking back from a metal doorknob, the other hand resting on a wooden doorframe; a cold draft enters behind.
scenes.note: 画的是进门时一只手缩离铁把手，另一只手扶着木门框。
scenes.scene_template: {A} steps through a winter doorway, one hand jerking back from a metal doorknob, the other hand resting on a wooden doorframe; a cold draft enters behind.

scenes.scene: The warm bare hand of short black hair, mustard yellow knit sweater, dark blue jeans hovers beside a cool metal block and a cool wood block; heat wisps leave the hand toward both, a steady stream toward metal and a weaker stream toward wood.
scenes.note: 画一只暖手同时向金属和木头散出热流，金属一侧更急。
scenes.scene_template: The warm bare hand of {A} hovers beside a cool metal block and a cool wood block; heat wisps leave the hand toward both, a steady stream toward metal and a weaker stream toward wood.

scenes.scene: short black hair, mustard yellow knit sweater, dark blue jeans and curly brown hair tied back, green long-sleeve shirt, black trousers press fingertips onto a metal countertop and a wood countertop; each fingertip is a small cup of warm water, with a thick pipe descending from the metal side and a thin straw from the wood side.
scenes.note: 画两个人的指尖像温水杯，金属下接粗管，木头下接细吸管。
scenes.scene_template: {A} and {B} press fingertips onto a metal countertop and a wood countertop; each fingertip is a small cup of warm water, with a thick pipe descending from the metal side and a thin straw from the wood side.

scenes.scene: A thick pipe from a warm fingertip cup runs through a large metal block into a room-sized reservoir; a thin straw from another cup ends in a bottle-cap-sized shallow pit that is full and blocked.
scenes.note: 画粗管通向大水库，细吸管通向已灌满堵住的小坑。
scenes.scene_template: A thick pipe from a warm fingertip cup runs through a large metal block into a room-sized reservoir; a thin straw from another cup ends in a bottle-cap-sized shallow pit that is full and blocked.

scenes.scene: Cross-section of short black hair, mustard yellow knit sweater, dark blue jeans's skin under metal and wood: many tiny cold-sensor beads glow under metal, few under wood; beside it, curly brown hair tied back, green long-sleeve shirt, black trousers's fingertip reddens on hot metal but stays calm on hot wood.
scenes.note: 画皮肤感受器在金属下密集发亮、木头下稀疏，旁边热金属烫红指尖而热木头无碍。
scenes.scene_template: Cross-section of {A}'s skin under metal and wood: many tiny cold-sensor beads glow under metal, few under wood; beside it, {B}'s fingertip reddens on hot metal but stays calm on hot wood.

scenes.scene: Barefoot short black hair, mustard yellow knit sweater, dark blue jeans steps with one foot on tile and one on thick carpet; nearby a pot with a plain wooden handle sits on a stove, and a glass of water waits on the counter.
scenes.note: 画光脚一只踩瓷砖一只踩地毯，旁边是木柄锅和一杯水。
